observation.command:
cd /tmp && API=http://localhost:8081; PY='docker run --rm -i display-server:latest python'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST $API/auth/signin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"id":"admin","password":"admin"}' | $PY -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["accessToken"])')
TENANT_ID=39605dab-2465-466f-b659-1b0bc138f426
curl -s -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookables -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Raum A","type":"room","isPublic":true,"isBookable":true,"isScheduleRelated":true,"isTimePeriodRelated":true,"amount":1,"maxAmountPerBooking":1,"minBookingDuration":15,"maxBookingDuration":480}' | head -c 1200
